scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Treat points as an airdrop bet
Hedge price if you only want the yield
scenes.vo: Restaking reuses staked assets to secure more services, paying extra rewards and often points: an off-chain score that may or may not become a token. The risk stack grows at each layer: staking to liquid restaking token to restaking protocol to each service it secures to slashing conditions. Professional rules: First, Plan with points at zero. Base the decision on yield you can measure. Next, Treat points as an airdrop bet: EV equals P(payout) times value minus costs. Then, Hedge price if you only want the yield: short the underlying perp (strategy #24), knowing the hedge doesn't cover a depeg of the restaking token. And finally, Cap it: speculative bucket only (at most 5 to 10% of DeFi capital).

scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. $20,000 in a liquid restaking token: base staking yield about 3% ($600 a year). Points: you estimate a 30% chance of a payout worth $1,500, costing $200 in gas and bridging: the calculator to EV $250. Worth doing only if the position still makes sense at $600 a year and the risk stack is acceptable.
